Q. Thiepval Memorial in France is a massive "interlocking" archway that stands 150 feet tall. The architect X used a complex mathematical progression to make the arches appear to "grow" out of each other. The walls are inscribed with the names of over 72,000 soldiers missing from the Battle of the Somme. X insisted on a specific, legible typeface so that families could find their loved ones among the thousands. Also known for designing another similar monument closer home. Id X.
